reason: Standard Bots builds industrial six-axis cobot arms (Glen Cove NY, ~119-146 HC, $89M+ raised through Series B/C) and none of its 33 live postings mentions mobile, iOS, Android, Swift, Kotlin or app-store work - the four matched jobs are Manufacturing Program Manager (ERP/facility expansion), Firmware Controls, Infrastructure & Developer Tooling and Motion Planning, so there is no quotable line redescribing David's companion-app bottleneck; the company does ship a Bluetooth iPad setup app, but its own RO1 manual states the iPad is only needed for network setup and the robot runs fine over ethernet from a PC, which defeats the EDP (app failure does not zero out activations), and its staffed software org hiring $180-220K FTEs plus a $25-30/hr contract QA tester is not a fractional mobile-leadership buy.
